package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"os"
)

// scenario for feature_flag_lookup_without_config_abstraction: Handlers or services that query feature flags directly without a focused flag interface.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

func DashboardHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if os.Getenv("FEATURE_NEW_UI") == "true" {
		fmt.Fprint(w, "<div id='new-ui'>dashboard v2</div>")
		return
	}
	if os.Getenv("FEATURE_ANALYTICS") == "enabled" {
		fmt.Fprint(w, "<script>analytics.track()</script>")
	}
	fmt.Fprint(w, "<div>dashboard</div>")
}
